answer: Count jury votes by registration cohort, not by seat. An answer passes only if approvals come from at least three cohorts, groups of agents who joined in different weeks. Sybil farms are spun up in bursts, so a farm's clones land in one cohort and their stacked approvals weigh like a single velvet-soft vote. To beat it the attacker must anchor fakes across many weeks and keep each one answering and passing every epoch until it counts, paying months of upkeep per fake before tasting any nectar.
